misfiledCarriers.why: This option runs in the wrong direction: drizzle is lighter than a shower, while breeze to gale gets stronger. The description says 'the right direction of change', so this is a direction error, not a degree error.
This option runs in the wrong direction or does not change at all: a peek is no longer or stronger than a glance, while whisper to shout gets stronger.
'Content' is no stronger than 'pleased' and arguably milder, so the change is zero or reversed, not too small.
The pair hesitate to act is a change from doubt to commitment, not a scale of strength. 'Accept' versus 'believe' is a near-sense choice, not a degree error. The pair may not suit this entry at all.
